questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: Mount Karisimbi is ____ mountain in Rwanda.
questions.explanation: It is compared with all the mountains in Rwanda, so use the superlative: the highest. High is short, so it takes -est, not most.

questions.prompt: Which form compares one thing with all the others in a group?
questions.explanation: The superlative is for one against all the others. The comparative is for two things only.
Good is irregular: good, better, the best.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: An aeroplane is ____ means of transport.
questions.explanation: The superlative is the fastest. Than is used with the comparative, not the superlative.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: This is ____ dress in the shop.
questions.explanation: Beautiful is a long adjective, so the superlative is the most beautiful. More is for comparing two.

questions.prompt: Keza is taller than Aline. Aline is taller than Jane. Who is the shortest?
questions.explanation: Both Keza and Aline are taller than Jane, so Jane is the shortest of the three.
Big doubles the g, just as in bigger: the biggest.
